title: Adaptive runtime policy catalog, phase-transition schedule, and provenance verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home checks, deterministic replay of campaign schedules, append-only pipeline validation, provenance audits, and retained-negative review.
preconditions: The measurement-only catalog, deterministic schedule artifacts, and append-only dataset contract are the only new tranche under review.
No active-controller application, online learning, public adaptive-policy API, or production exploration is included in this verification slice.
The local-result and epoch-dataset schemas remain versioned review contracts for offline analysis and provenance.
scope: Verify the measurement-only policy catalog, deterministic phase-transition schedules, explicit missingness and join semantics, and append-only raw-to-split provenance chain only. This artifact does not verify active controller application, a wider policy axis, or a publishable ProtocolLab performance claim.
expected_result: Catalog entries remain non-authoritative and cannot affect runtime behavior; campaign schedules replay deterministically with the same phase boundaries, treatment order, and command lineage; missingness and join failures retain explicit reasons rather than being hidden; raw, normalized, curated, and split layers remain append-only; and every retained row links back to repository state, binary hashes, workload shape, policy values, source artifacts, and transformation version.
procedure: Validate ARC-QUIC-CRT-0062, WI-QUIC-CRT-0063, and VER-QUIC-CRT-0064 individually against model/model.schema.json; verify unique IDs and reciprocal direct links to REQ-QUIC-CRT-0170 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0172.
Run deterministic replay of the documented phase-transition schedules and confirm the same treatment order, phase boundaries, and command lineage across repeated executions.
Validate representative positive and negative catalog, schedule, and dataset records against the repository's existing review contracts and the local-result and epoch-dataset schemas.
Prove missing, stale, contradictory, and unmatched joins retain explicit reason codes and remain addressable as negative evidence.
Prove the raw, normalized, curated, and split layers are append-only and that supersession appends new records instead of rewriting prior ones.
Audit provenance fields for repository state, binary hashes, workload shape, policy values, source artifacts, and transformation version.
Run git diff --check and record the pre-existing repo-wide SpecTrace validation backlog separately from the validation status of the touched artifacts.
